teaser.en: Touch it once and you will never forget its name: its hairy leaves leave the skin itching.
teaser.sw: Ukiugusa mara moja hutalisahau jina lake kamwe: majani yake yenye manyoya huacha ngozi ikiwasha.
teaser.dg: Uchiuguta mara mwenga tu, kundariyala dzinare: makodzage genye nyere ganaawisa ngozi.

summary.en: Mwamdzavi is Tragia furialis, a hairy, twining herb whose leaves make the skin itch on contact. Its name also serves as a general Digo term for itchy plants.
summary.sw: Mwamdzavi ni Tragia furialis, mmea wenye manyoya unaojizungusha, ambao majani yake huwasha ngozi yanapoigusa. Jina lake pia hutumika kama neno la jumla la Kidigo kwa mimea inayowasha.
summary.dg: Mwamdzavi ni Tragia furialis, mmea wenye nyere unaodzilinga-linga, ambao makodzage ganaawisa ngozi gachiiguta. Dzinare piya nkuhumirwa ni Adigo kpwa mimea yosi inayoawisa.

about.en: Mwamdzavi is a slender, twining or sprawling herb covered in stinging hairs. Its leaves are heart-shaped, toothed and hairy. The flowers are tiny and greenish, and the fruits are small, hairy, three-lobed capsules. Mgombato describes it as a plant with hairy, heart-shaped leaves that irritates when it touches the skin, and Pakia records that the Digo recognise it both by sight and by the itching it causes.
about.sw: Mwamdzavi ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha au kutambaa, uliofunikwa na manyoya yanayouma. Majani yake yana umbo la moyo, yenye meno na manyoya. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani-kijani, na matunda ni vifuko vidogo vyenye manyoya na sehemu tatu. Mgombato unaueleza kuwa mmea wenye majani ya umbo la moyo yenye manyoya, unaowasha unapogusa ngozi, na Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa kuuona na pia kwa mwasho unaosababisha.
about.dg: Mwamdzavi ni mmea mwembamba unaodzilinga-linga au unaoambala photsi, uriofwinikpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra moyo, gana meno kanda-kanda na gana nyere. Maruwa ni madide sana na ga chijani ngushu-ngushu, na matunda ni makakaya madide genye nyere na seemu tahu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inauandika dza mmea wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo genye nyere, unaoawisa uchiguta ngozi, na Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa kuuona na kpwa vira unavyoawisa.

where.en: It grows in bushland, thicket and along forest edges, scrambling through other plants.
where.sw: Huota vichakani, kwenye vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ukitambaa katikati ya mimea mingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchiambala kahi ya mimea yanjina.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Mwamdzavi is also a collective word for itchy plants, covering both Tragia furialis and Laportea lanceolata, a nettle. Pakia adds that identifying a plant by its itch, as here or with the velvet bean Uphupu, is usually accidental rather than intended.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba Mwamdzavi pia ni neno la jumla kwa mimea inayowasha, likijumuisha Tragia furialis na Laportea lanceolata, aina ya kiwavi. Pakia anaongeza kwamba kutambua mmea kwa mwasho wake, kama hapa au kwa upupu (Uphupu), kwa kawaida hutokea kwa bahati mbaya badala ya kukusudiwa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Mwamdzavi piya ni neno ra kuihira mimea yosi inayoawisa, kahi yao Tragia furialis na Laportea lanceolata, mmea wa jamii ya *nettle*. Pakia anaenjereza kukala kuumanya mmea kpwa vira unavyoawisa, dza hipha au dza Uphupu (*velvet bean*), kpwa kawaida ni kpwa bahati, si kpwa kusudi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamdzavi, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Mgombato lists mwamdzavi with the variant mwamlavi. The genus is known in English as noseburn; its scientific name is Tragia furialis, spelled Tragea in Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwamdzavi, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Mgombato unaorodhesha mwamdzavi pamoja na tofauti yake mwamlavi. Kwa Kiingereza jenasi hii inajulikana kama *noseburn*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Tragia furialis, linaloandikwa Tragea katika Pakia.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamdzavi, rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mwamdzavi*, na piya *mwamlavi*. Kpwa Chingereza jenasi ihi inaihwa *noseburn*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Tragia furialis, ambaro Pakia anariandika *Tragea*.
